description: `commitMessageTopic` drops the word `dependency`, so the longest scoped package name still fits the 90-character limit that the pull request title check sets.

No digest-pinning preset is extended, because the `images` and `actions` package rules already set `pinDigests: true`. `:pinDigests` is not a real preset, and Renovate rejects a config that extends it.

`minimumReleaseAge` matches pnpm's one-day minimum release age, so Renovate proposes only versions that `pnpm install` accepts. `internalChecksFilter: strict` keeps a version that is too new out of the branch instead of opening a pull request that waits for it.

`prConcurrentLimit` is 12 and `prHourlyLimit` is off because a normal weekend opens seven or more group branches, and Monday adds two lock-maintenance pull requests. A limit of six held some of them back to a later run.

customManagers.description: Updates each `ARG <NAME>_VERSION=` line that follows a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment, because the `dockerfile` manager reads only `FROM`. It runs only while `enabledManagers` lists `custom.regex`, and `packages/devtools/test/ci/deploy-tree.test.ts` requires it to stay the first regex manager.
Updates the uv version in `apps/worker/.tool-versions`, which CI installs and no enabled manager reads. The `uv` rule below groups it with the worker image's `ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv`.

Updates the pstack release tag in `.claude/settings.json`, which no enabled manager reads. pstack scripts run in every session with the session's permissions, so each release must arrive as a pull request that someone reviews.

Updates the pgvector image tag and digest in `packages/schema/src/postgres-image.ts`, which no enabled manager reads. The versioning treats the `pgN` in the tag as the major, so a rule below holds each Postgres major for approval.

packageRules.description: Groups every npm minor, patch, pin, and digest update into one pull request, because each npm update rewrites the shared `pnpm-lock.yaml` and separate pull requests conflict. One group also keeps a package at one version in every workspace, which `packages/devtools/test/ci/dependency-versions.test.ts` enforces.
Follows cloc's `latest` npm tag, because its highest version number (2.11.0) is an older release that sorts above the current one.

Moves better-auth, its plugins, and the `@simplewebauthn` libraries together, because the api and the web pin some of them directly and those pins must match better-auth's. This rule must stay after the npm non-major rule so that its group name wins.

Holds `@better-auth/utils` at 0.5.0, the exact version that better-auth requires. `packages/devtools/test/ci/dependency-versions.test.ts` fails until this hold matches better-auth's installed dependency.
Holds `@simplewebauthn` below 14, because `@better-auth/passkey` requires `^13`. `packages/devtools/test/ci/dependency-versions.test.ts` fails until this hold matches passkey's installed range.

Turns off updates to the worker's `requires-python`, because it names the interpreter the worker runs on and is not a package pin. Change it in the same commit as the image's `python` base and `.python-version`.

Holds the worker image's `python` base on 3.13, the version that `pyproject.toml` and `.python-version` name, because the build uses the base's interpreter and `uv sync --frozen` fails on another minor. Rebuilt digests and 3.13 patch releases still arrive in the `images` group.
Groups the uv that CI installs from `apps/worker/.tool-versions` with the `ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv` image in `apps/worker/Dockerfile`, so that CI and the worker image always use the same uv.

prBodyNotes: Merging this leaves production behind: re-point the Coolify Postgres resource to the new image reference by hand, and run `ALTER EXTENSION vector UPDATE` when the pgvector version moved (`docs/operations/local-gates.md`, *The shared test Postgres*).
packageRules.description: Production's Postgres is a Coolify resource set by hand to this image, so each pull request for this pin lists the manual steps that merging leaves.

A Postgres major upgrade also moves production's resource, the backup image's `postgresql-client`, and the dump. It waits for approval in the Dependency Dashboard instead of being turned off, so that it stays visible.
